definitions.gloss: to accomplish, to fulfill, to carry out completely
definitions.explanation: To see something through to the end, especially a duty, responsibility, or role. Implies completing something fully and properly.

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}を{全|まっと}うする。
{自分|じぶん}の{役割|やくわり}を{最後|さいご}まで{全|まっと}うした。
examples.english: I carried out my role to the very end.

examples.japanese: {天寿|てんじゅ}を{全|まっと}うして、{祖母|そぼ}は{穏|おだ}やかに{亡|な}くなった。
examples.english: Having lived out her natural lifespan, my grandmother passed away peacefully.

notes:
A formal and somewhat literary verb. Carries a sense of dignity and completeness in fulfilling one's purpose.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{責任|せきにん}を{全|まっと}うする (fulfill one's responsibility)
・{役割|やくわり}を{全|まっと}うする (carry out one's role)
・{使命|しめい}を{全|まっと}うする (accomplish one's mission)
・{天寿|てんじゅ}を{全|まっと}うする (live out one's natural lifespan)
・{任期|にんき}を{全|まっと}うする (serve out one's term)

Also written as {全|まっと}うする or まっとうする. The kanji {全|まっと} is read まっとう here, not ぜん.
